newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Arterial Vascular started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Arterial Vascular started.

text.p: Piper Jaffray said it initiated coverage of Arterial Vascular Engineering Inc with a buy.
-- said expects Arterial Vascular to post "roughly flat sequential earnings per share comparisons for the next four quarters or so."
-- said sequential sales comparions will also be relatively flat until the company gets reimbursement approval for its products in Japan in late 1997 or early 1998.
-- said by mid-1998, Arterial Vascular should be poised for "dramatic pickup" in both sales and earnings.
